supervision: context agreement at scales1.5/2, both margin>=.01; foreground-erasure class cosine drop>=.01; both source correspondence endpoints must agree; unaccepted unknown
context_policy_not_truth: heuristic source evidence, must verify against real labels
readout_control: explicit optional sigmoid(10*(positive cosine - maximum generic alternative cosine)); fixed object/things/stuff/texture, common to scenes; no map updates
evaluation: same real-label polygons and fixed .5 threshold; do not tune to individual categories
